However in case of Electronic forms printouts of such applications need not be retained or sent to the issuer. Intermediaries shall at all times maintain the electronic records relating to such forms for a minimum period of three years."

dataList.value: "3-Sep-2026 (upto 5:00 PM) The new cut-off time for UPI mandate acceptance is 05:00 PM on last day of IPO bidding. tijori.business_description: Deepa Jewellers Ltd., incorporated in 2016, operates in the B2B jewellery segment, engaged in designing, processing and supplying hallmarked gold jewellery, along with jobwork and trading of jewellery, precious stones, silver ornaments and gold bullion.
